contentHtml:
Taco pizza is a fun, flavor-packed mashup that combines the best of two favorites into one irresistible dish. A crispy golden crust is topped with seasoned beef, black beans, and plenty of melted cheddar and Monterey Jack cheese for a savory, satisfying base. Fresh toppings like pico de gallo, sour cream, guacamole, lettuce, and cilantro add brightness and crunch, turning every slice into a mini fiesta. With smoky paprika, cumin, and a splash of lime juice in the mix, taco pizza is the perfect weeknight dinner to share with family or friends—easy to make, exciting to eat, and always a crowd-pleaser.

Why You’ll Love This TACO PIZZA

  • It’s a delicious fusion of two favorites: tacos and pizza!
  • Customizable toppings let you create your perfect slice.
  • Quick and easy to make, perfect for busy weeknights.
  • Great for sharing with family and friends at gatherings.
  • Packed with flavor and freshness, it’s a crowd-pleaser!

TACO PIZZA

Discover how to make amazing taco pizza at home! 🍕🌮 A delicious fusion of flavors that will delight your taste buds!
Print Recipe Pin Recipe
Prep Time 10 minutes mins
Cook Time 15 minutes mins
cooling 5 minutes mins
Total Time 30 minutes mins
Servings: 4 servings
Course: Main Course
Cuisine: Mexican
Calories: 350
Ingredients Equipment Method Notes

Ingredients
  

Dough
  • 1 dough pizza dough your favorite type, store-bought or homemade
Sauce
  • ½ cup salsa for a tasty base sauce
Meat
  • 300 g ground beef seasoned with taco spices
  • 2 tbsp taco seasoning for flavoring the beef
Cheese
  • 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese adds sharp, creamy flavor
  • 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese for that gooey texture
Toppings
  • 1 cup chopped lettuce for freshness and crunch
  • ½ cup diced tomatoes adds juiciness and color
  • ¼ cup sliced black olives for a briny touch
  • ¼ cup sliced jalapenos for some heat
  • to taste sour cream for drizzling on top
  • to taste chopped cilantro for garnish

Equipment

  • 1 Skillet For cooking the ground beef.
  • 1 Baking sheet For baking the pizza.

Method
 

Preparation Steps
  1. Preheat your oven to 220°C (425°F). This will ensure your pizza bakes perfectly.
  2. In a skillet over medium heat, cook the ground beef with taco seasoning until it’s nicely browned. Don’t forget to drain any excess fat!
  3. Roll out your pizza dough on a baking sheet. Make sure it’s nice and even for the best results.
  4. Spread salsa evenly over the surface of the dough. This will be the flavorful base of your pizza.
  5. Sprinkle the cooked beef over the salsa, then layer on the cheddar and mozzarella cheeses. Yum!
  6. Pop the pizza in the oven and bake for 12–15 minutes. Keep an eye on it until the crust is golden and the cheese is melted.
  7. Once out of the oven, top your pizza with lettuce, tomatoes, olives, and jalapenos for that fresh crunch.
  8. Drizzle sour cream over the top and sprinkle with cilantro. Slice it up and serve immediately. Enjoy your TACO PIZZA!

How to Make TACO PIZZA

Get ready to whip up a delicious TACO PIZZA! This recipe takes about 10 minutes to prepare, 12–15 minutes to cook, and a few extra minutes to let it cool before serving. Let’s dive in!

Step 1: Preheat the Oven

Preheat your oven to 220°C (425°F). This will ensure your pizza bakes perfectly.

Step 2: Cook the Beef

In a skillet over medium heat, cook the ground beef with taco seasoning until it’s nicely browned. Don’t forget to drain any excess fat!

Step 3: Prepare the Dough

Roll out your pizza dough on a baking sheet. Make sure it’s nice and even for the best results.

Step 4: Add Salsa

Spread salsa evenly over the surface of the dough. This will be the flavorful base of your pizza.

Step 5: Layer the Toppings

Sprinkle the cooked beef over the salsa, then layer on the cheddar and mozzarella cheeses. Yum!

Step 6: Bake the Pizza

Pop the pizza in the oven and bake for 12–15 minutes. Keep an eye on it until the crust is golden and the cheese is melted.

Step 7: Add Fresh Toppings

Once out of the oven, top your pizza with lettuce, tomatoes, olives, and jalapenos for that fresh crunch.

Step 8: Drizzle and Serve

Drizzle sour cream over the top and sprinkle with cilantro. Slice it up and serve immediately. Enjoy your PIZZA!

Recipe Snapshot

Pro Tips for Making TACO PIZZA

  • Opt for a pre-made pizza crust for a quick and easy base.
  • Use ground turkey or chicken as a leaner protein alternative.
  • Add fresh toppings like lettuce and tomatoes right before serving.
  • Experiment with different cheeses for a unique flavor twist.
  • Serve with a side of salsa or guacamole for extra zest.

How to Serve this TACO PIZZA

  • Slice into wedges for easy sharing.
  • Top with fresh cilantro and avocado slices.
  • Serve with a side of sour cream or Greek yogurt.
  • Pair with a refreshing limeade or iced tea.
  • Offer a variety of hot sauces for extra kick.
  • Enjoy with a simple green salad for a balanced meal.

Make Ahead and Storage

Here’s how to keep your Pizza fresh and delicious:

Storing TACO PIZZA Leftovers

  • Allow the pizza to cool completely.
  • Wrap slices in plastic wrap or aluminum foil.
  • Store in an airtight container in the fridge.
  • Consume within 3-4 days for best quality.

Freezing TACO PIZZA

  • Cool the pizza completely before freezing.
  • Wrap tightly in plastic wrap, then in foil.
  • Label with the date and type of pizza.
  • Freeze for up to 2-3 months for optimal taste.

Reheating TACO PIZZA

  • Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
  • Place pizza slices on a baking sheet.
  • Cover with foil to retain moisture.
  • Heat for about 10-15 minutes until warm.

FAQs

Here’s a helpful FAQ about this recipe:

1. What comes on a taco pizza?

A taco pizza typically features a delicious combination of seasoned ground beef or turkey, refried beans, cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, and taco sauce. You can also add toppings like jalapeños, olives, and sour cream to enhance the flavor. The crust is usually a traditional pizza base, making it a fun fusion of two beloved dishes!

2. Does Pizza Hut still make taco pizza?

As of my last update, Pizza Hut has discontinued their taco pizza from the menu. However, menu offerings can vary by location, so it’s always a good idea to check with your local Pizza Hut to see if they have any special promotions or limited-time offerings that might include a taco pizza!

3. Does Domino’s have a taco pizza?

Domino’s does not have a taco pizza on their standard menu. However, you can create your own version by customizing a pizza with taco-inspired toppings like seasoned beef, cheese, and fresh veggies. It’s a great way to enjoy a taco pizza experience from the comfort of your home!

4. Does Papa Murphy’s make a taco pizza?

Yes! Papa Murphy’s offers a taco pizza that you can take and bake at home. It typically includes a variety of toppings like seasoned beef, cheese, and fresh vegetables, allowing you to enjoy a fresh taco pizza right out of your oven. Be sure to check their menu for the latest offerings!

Final Thoughts

Now that you’ve got the scoop on making your very own Taco Pizza, it’s time to gather your loved ones and dig in! This dish is not just a meal; it’s a celebration of flavors and fun. So roll up your sleeves, get creative, and enjoy every cheesy, zesty bite. Happy cooking!
